summary: Iter53 testing: 10/10 executable backend+static smoke tests PASS (4 skipped: 3 dedup + 1 gpt-5.2 502-ingress-timeout). The new /api/ai/generate-complete-app wrapper (asyncio.shield + _run_in_background) is verified end-to-end using emergentintegrations LlmChat with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY: claude-haiku returned 200 with `code.files` non-empty array in ~95s. gpt-5.2 itself returned 502 BadGateway from OpenAI upstream (cascade activates, falls through claude-sonnet/gpt-5/etc., but proxy ingress drops at 60s) — this is an external LLM provider hiccup, NOT a code defect (cf. backend logs ~19:56-20:01: 'litellm.BadGatewayError: BadGatewayError: OpenAIException - Error code: 502'). Contract endpoints /api/messages/delete-thread, /api/devices/block, /api/devices/unblock all reject unsigned payloads (422) and the deleteContact handler in MessagesPanel.jsx NO LONGER calls /devices/revoke (statically verified). Static UI: TheftButton labelled variant ships data-testid='theft-labelled-btn' with t('theft_short') ('Déclarer un vol' FR / 'Report theft' EN), Landing.js places it in the LEFT justify-self-start block, Dashboard.js places it on the LEFT next to LanguageToggle. MessagesPanel uses <Ban/> for block (data-testid='block-contact-btn') and <ShieldCheck/> for unblock (data-testid='unblock-contact-btn'); all block/unblock/rename/delete-contact/delete-thread buttons are inside `isCreator && selected` guard. Visual Playwright verification on Landing: TheftButton labelled rendered at x=454 with text 'Report theft' ✓. ONE FRONTEND BUG: MessageButton (icon variant) does NOT render on Landing for fresh anonymous visitors because of guard `if (!device.keyId) return null;` at MessageButton.jsx L37 — review requirement #2 explicitly demands the icon be visible on the Landing header before LanguageToggle.

minor.issue: OpenAI upstream returns 502 BadGateway intermittently; cascade fallback works but each retry costs ~60s and the request exceeds the 60s ingress timeout. Wrapper (asyncio.shield) means the project IS still persisted server-side. Validated via claude-haiku which completed in ~95s and returned a valid {code:{files:[...]}, project, preview_url, ai_source}.

ui_bugs.issue: Returns null when device.keyId is unset (line 37 of /app/frontend/src/components/MessageButton.jsx). On Landing page for a fresh anonymous visitor (no localStorage device identity), the button does NOT render — Playwright count=0. Review-request #2 says the icon must be visible on Landing 'à DROITE avant LanguageToggle'. After login/device-registration the button renders correctly. FIX OPTIONS: (a) drop the !device.keyId guard for variant=='icon' on public pages and let the click open MessagesPanel in a 'send-to-creator' guest mode, OR (b) only enforce the requirement on Dashboard (post-auth) — adjust the review spec accordingly.

action_items: Decide MessageButton visibility policy for fresh visitors: either remove the !device.keyId guard so the icon shows on Landing (and degrade gracefully on click for guests), or update review requirement #2 to scope to authenticated headers only.

Monitor OpenAI gpt-5.2 502 rate: the cascade is functioning but currently the FIRST model (gpt-5.2) is failing and the proxy 60s timeout means clients see 502s even though backend completes in the background. Consider re-ordering the default cascade to start with claude-haiku/sonnet while gpt-5.2 upstream is unhealthy, OR exposing a polling endpoint so the frontend can resume after the proxy drop.
critical_code_review_comments: MessageButton.jsx L37 — `if (!device.keyId) return null;` is the root cause of the Landing-page invisibility. Same guard applies for variant='icon' (header) and variant='inline'/'floating'. Recommend splitting the guard: render the icon always for variant=='icon' but skip the polling effect when keyId is null, and let MessagesPanel handle the guest case.

MessagesPanel.jsx deleteContact (L146-165) — correctly removed the /devices/revoke call as required by iter53. Only /messages/delete-thread is invoked. Comment block at L150-155 documents the intentional behaviour. ✓
MessagesPanel.jsx L260-282 — Ban / ShieldCheck conditional render based on `sel?.role === 'blocked'` is correct. Both icons imported from lucide-react (L3).

server.py L1808-2151 _ai_generate_complete_app_impl — uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; cascade chain dedupes (line 1994-1999) and silently falls through on per-model errors; final fallback to generate_basic_template prevents 500s. Solid. Smoke verified.

server.py L4628-4658 devices/block — issues 'role: blocked' update + nonce wipe + session wipe + decision log. Correctly creates a stub `device_keys` doc when target unknown so future re-registrations stay blocked. ✓

server.py L5290-5295 messages/delete-thread — deletes by thread_key_id only (no per-user scoping). Acceptable because /messages/* are signature-gated to the creator and the thread_key_id is unique per peer device.
Landing.js L72-76 — MessageButton sits BETWEEN CreatorToolbar and LanguageToggle. Static position correct, but render is suppressed by MessageButton's own guard (see ui_bugs).
Dashboard.js L697 places TheftButton labelled IMMEDIATELY after LanguageToggle in the LEFT cluster. Review-request says 'à GAUCHE (à côté LanguageToggle)' — match ✓.

success_rate.frontend: static UI 100% (5/5); runtime UI 50% — TheftButton labelled visible & correctly placed; MessageButton missing on Landing for anonymous visitors

seed_data_creation: claude-haiku generation test created 1 project + 1 preview in MongoDB (under test user, normal user data, no cleanup needed). No other DB mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter53 backend smoke is GREEN. ONE pending frontend fix: MessageButton.jsx L37 guard `if (!device.keyId) return null;` hides the icon on Landing for fresh visitors. Once main agent decides the policy (always-render vs auth-gated), re-run test_iter53_smoke.py and repeat the Playwright Landing check: `await page.locator('[data-testid="message-creator-icon-btn"]').count()` should be >= 1 on a fresh page load. The gpt-5.2 cascade issue is environmental (OpenAI upstream 502) — re-test in a few hours, or accept claude-haiku as the smoke proof. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_smoke.py is self-contained and idempotent.
rca of the issue: MessageButton invisibility on Landing for anonymous visitors: MessageButton.jsx L37 returns null when device.keyId is undefined. The hook useDeviceIdentity only populates keyId after device registration (POST /api/devices/register on user opt-in). Therefore: anonymous visitor → no key → no MessageButton DOM node → fails review-#2. FIX: replace the early-return with a conditional disable+open-panel-in-guest-mode behaviour for variant=='icon', OR scope the requirement to authenticated headers only and accept the current behaviour on Landing. gpt-5.2 502: OpenAI provider returned `BadGatewayError: OpenAIException - Error code: 502` on 3 consecutive retries during the smoke window — fully external. Cascade in server.py L1985-2054 reacts as designed (silent fallback to claude-sonnet, gpt-5, gemini, claude-haiku, gpt-5, claude-opus) so functionality is preserved when the proxy timeout isn't an issue.
